+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FilterMetricDimensionsRequest:
+    metric_name: str
+    start_time: Optional[datetime] = None
+    end_time: Optional[datetime] = None
+    dimensions: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+    labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+    limit: int = 100
+
+
+def _iso(dt: datetime) -> str:
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+def _build_filter_expression(dimensions: Optional[Dict[str, str]], labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]]) -> str:
+    clauses: List[str] = []
+    for source in (dimensions or {}, labels or {}):
+        for key, value in source.items():
+            safe_key = key.replace('"', '\\"')
+            safe_value = value.replace('"', '\\"')
+            clauses.append(f'{safe_key} = "{safe_value}"')
+    return " AND ".join(clauses)
+
+
+def query_metric_dimensions(request: FilterMetricDimensionsRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_API_KEY")
+    app_key = os.environ.get("DATADOG_APP_KEY")
+    if not api_key or not app_key:
+        raise ValueError("DATADOG_API_KEY and DATADOG_APP_KEY are required")
+
+    end_time = request.end_time or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    start_time = request.start_time or (end_time - timedelta(hours=1))
+    filter_expression = _build_filter_expression(request.dimensions, request.labels)
+    query = request.metric_name if not filter_expression else f"{request.metric_name}{{{filter_expression}}}"
+
+    params = {
+        "from": int(start_time.timestamp()),
+        "to": int(end_time.timestamp()),
+        "query": query,
+        "page[size]": request.limit,
+    }
+    response = requests.get(
+        "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/query",
+        headers={
+            "DD-API-KEY": api_key,
+            "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": app_key,
+        },
+        params=params,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return {
+        "metric_name": request.metric_name,
+        "query": query,
+        "start_time": _iso(start_time),
+        "end_time": _iso(end_time),
+        "series": payload.get("series", []),
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    metric = os.environ.get("METRIC_NAME", "system.cpu.user")
+    request = FilterMetricDimensionsRequest(metric_name=metric)
+    result = query_metric_dimensions(request)
+    print(result)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

            "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": cfg.datadog_app_key,

        }
    )

    return session

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Optional
+
+import boto3
+from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    value = os.getenv(name, default)
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {name}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _to_utc_datetime(value: Any) -> datetime:
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        dt = value
+    elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(value, tz=timezone.utc)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip()
+        if text.endswith("Z"):
+            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    else:
+        raise TypeError(f"Unsupported datetime value: {type(value)!r}")
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MetricExportArchiveRequest:
+    snapshot_id: str
+    metric_name: str
+    export_payload: Mapping[str, Any]
+    archived_at: datetime
+    bucket: Optional[str] = None
+    object_key: Optional[str] = None
+    content_type: str = "application/json"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "archived_at", _to_utc_datetime(self.archived_at))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MetricExportArchiveResult:
+    snapshot_id: str
+    metric_name: str
+    archived_at: datetime
+    bucket: str
+    object_key: str
+    object_uri: str
+
+
+def _default_bucket() -> str:
+    return _env("AWS_METRICS_ARCHIVE_BUCKET")
+
+
+def _build_object_key(request: MetricExportArchiveRequest) -> str:
+    safe_metric = request.metric_name.strip().replace("/", "_")
+    ts = request.archived_at.strftime("%Y/%m/%d/%H%M%S")
+    return request.object_key or f"metric-archives/{safe_metric}/{request.snapshot_id}/{ts}.json"
+
+
+def archive_metric_export(request: MetricExportArchiveRequest) -> MetricExportArchiveResult:
+    bucket = request.bucket or _default_bucket()
+    object_key = _build_object_key(request)
+    client = boto3.client("s3")
+    body = __import__("json").dumps(
+        {
+            "snapshot_id": request.snapshot_id,
+            "metric_name": request.metric_name,
+            "archived_at": request.archived_at.isoformat(),
+            "export_payload": request.export_payload,
+        },
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        default=str,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    try:
+        client.put_object(
+            Bucket=bucket,
+            Key=object_key,
+            Body=body,
+            ContentType=request.content_type,
+        )
+    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to archive metric export to s3://{bucket}/{object_key}") from exc
+    return MetricExportArchiveResult(
+        snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id,
+        metric_name=request.metric_name,
+        archived_at=request.archived_at,
+        bucket=bucket,
+        object_key=object_key,
+        object_uri=f"s3://{bucket}/{object_key}",
+    )
+

+    "archive_metric_export",
+]
